dishes.make_ahead: Peel the prawns and mix the pink sauce up to 1 day ahead, separately in the fridge; shred the cos, dice the avocado and assemble just before serving

steps.text: Peel and devein the cooked king prawns, leaving a few tails on for the tops.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the Worcestershire, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth.
Shred the cos heart and divide between the small glasses.
Add diced avocado and the prawns, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.

veg.n: Dreamhouse pink hearts of palm cocktail cups
veg.make_ahead: Cut the hearts of palm and mix the pink sauce up to 1 day ahead, separately in the fridge; shred the cos, dice the avocado and assemble just before serving

ingredients.item: cans hearts of palm (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Cut the hearts of palm into thick rounds and pat dry.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the soy sauce, a few drops of hot sauce and the juice of half a lemon until pink and smooth.
Shred the cos heart and divide between the small glasses.
Add diced avocado and the hearts of palm, spoon over the sauce, dust with paprika and add a lemon wedge.

dishes.n: Beach Ken watermelon and feta skewers
dishes.make_ahead: Cut and chill the watermelon, feta and cucumber up to 1 day ahead, kept separately in the fridge; thread the skewers and dress just before serving

steps.text: Cut a quarter of a watermelon into 3cm cubes and chill well.
Cut the firm feta and the continental cucumber into similar cubes.
Thread onto the skewers in the order watermelon, mint leaf, feta, cucumber, watermelon.
Lay on a platter, squeeze over the juice of the lime and drizzle with the olive oil.
Mix the salt with a little chilli flakes and sprinkle over just before serving.

dishes.make_ahead: Roast and blend the beetroot sauce up to 2 days ahead and keep chilled; warm it with a splash of pasta water and toss through the penne on the night

steps.text: Roast the beetroot wrapped in foil at 200C for 50 minutes, peel and blend with the ricotta, the garlic clove, the parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Toss through the cooked penne until glossy and pink, and crumble the goat's cheese over the top.

dishes.make_ahead: Blitz the strawberry sauce up to 1 day ahead and keep it covered in the fridge; make the waffles and whip the cream on the day

steps.text: Make the waffles from the waffle mix.
Blitz the strawberries with the sugar for a pink sauce.
Whip the cream.
Stack the waffles with cream, the sliced strawberries and the pink sauce poured over.

dishes.make_ahead: Dip and chill the glass rims up to 1 day ahead; blend the shake just before serving

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate and dip the rims of the tall glasses in it, then into the sprinkles.
Chill the glasses 10 minutes.
Blend the hulled strawberries with the vanilla ice cream, the cold milk and the honey until thick and pink.
Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and a halved strawberry.
